audience: new LLC owners seeking clearer funding-readiness requirements
customer_problem: specific funding-readiness complaints and documentation gaps remain difficult to verify
transformation: replace funding-readiness guesswork with a documented preparation checklist

draft_copy.headline: Funding readiness starts with a clearer first step.
draft_copy.body: Before applying, organize the business profile, documents, and questions a lender may require. This is educational readiness guidance—not a funding guarantee.
draft_copy.disclosure: No guaranteed approval, amount, rate, or funding outcome.

limitations: No funding approval or eligibility claim
